items.m: As long as you come, I'll be happy.

items.a: 做完作业，你才能看电视。
items.m: You can only watch TV once you've finished your homework.
As long as the weather is nice, we'll go hiking.

items.a: 每天复习，你才能记住这些字。
items.m: Only if you revise every day will you remember these characters.
Whenever she isn't busy, she goes to see her mum.
We can only go if he agrees.

items.a: 你说得慢一点儿，我就能听懂。
items.m: As long as you speak a bit more slowly, I can understand.
He only has time at the weekend.
As long as you want to go, go.
As long as it doesn't rain, we'll go.
Whenever I have time, I read.
As long as you take it seriously, you'll do well in the exam.

r: 只有他来了，我们才能开始。
items.m: We can only start once he's here.

items.s: 只要你认真学，才能学好。
r: 只要你认真学，就能学好。
o: 只要你认真学，能学好就。
只要你认真学，能就学好。
items.m: As long as you study carefully, you'll learn it well.
As long as the weather is nice, we'll go.
He's only at home on Sundays.

items.s: 只要明天不忙，我去就看你。
r: 只要明天不忙，我就去看你。
o: 只要明天不忙，我去看你就。
只要明天不忙，我去看就你。
items.m: As long as I'm not busy tomorrow, I'll come and see you.
